# eyeland.cards

> An open-world card-combat MMORPG across a floating archipelago: explore islands like Pokemon, build a deck like Hearthstone, and duel with a hand of cards like Wizard101.

eyeland.cards is the landing page for a game currently in Unity pre-alpha, built in the open with Unity and Claude. The plan ships in order: a readable card duel first (pips, hands, turns, spell resolution, win state), then a starter spellbook and deck-building, then a walkable island with wild encounters, then more islands and a collection loop, and only then the online/MMO layer (friends, trading, duels). The first public build is a pre-alpha itch.io release, not yet shipped. The page shows three sample cards from the starter set (Ember Bolt, Tidewisp, Eye of the Storm) and a five-step build ladder (Duel, Deck, Island, World, Online), with "Duel" as the current step.

There is no payment, account, or download yet. The only action on the page is an email signup that opens a pre-filled mailto to adamtpang@gmail.com requesting the first itch.io build link when it exists; there is no backend capture.

## Key links
- [Home](https://eyelandcards.vercel.app/): hero, how-it-plays pillars, card showcase, build ladder, and the itch.io signup.
- [The World](https://eyelandcards.vercel.app/#world): the open-world / island-hopping pillar.
- [The Cards](https://eyelandcards.vercel.app/#cards): the deckbuilding and card-duel pillars, with sample cards.
- [First Build](https://eyelandcards.vercel.app/#build): the v0-v4 build ladder from duel prototype to full MMO.
- [Get the build](https://eyelandcards.vercel.app/#waitlist): join to get the first itch.io pre-alpha link.

Note: the brand and eventual domain is eyeland.cards; the site is currently deployed at eyelandcards.vercel.app (matches robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and canonical tag).
